@magandamorning1279  muka pong na misunderstood nyo din yung comment. 
Tama po kayo sa point na if gusto mo yumaman, dont buy
Insurance. But if you want insurance, then just buy insurance.
Yung sinasabi po kasi nung original na nagcomment is about the additional fees ng insurance company with the so called investment. Medyo malaki po kasi yung oppotunity cost na mawawla because of that fees. 
If you want insurance, just buy a term one, which is more affordable. Yung difference, you can invest it in index fund, mutual fund or even bonds depending on you risk tolerance.
